original_test_intent: Complete the approved NVIDIA NVSSVT L0 and L1 qualification for the Grace software/firmware stack and demonstrate a 100% pass rate.
original_method: An authorized operator pins the supported platform, references, NVSSVT package and complete suite manifest, runs the documented vendor workflow in an approved window, preserves every result and verifies the denominator independently.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the licensed NVSSVT bundle and manifest; an authorized operator launches the pinned L0/L1 suite, monitors the Grace platform and reviews every result behind the 100% calculation.
required_inputs: NVSSVT package/version/hash, license and supported launcher
Complete required L0/L1 case manifest and dependency graph
Grace hardware, SBIOS, firmware, OS, kernel, driver and CUDA compatibility matrix
Required privileges, services, fixtures, network and artifact storage
Expected runtime, reboot/reset/stress behavior and per-case timeout
Exact denominator, skip/waiver/retry and infrastructure-error policy
Independent console, power/thermal monitoring and recovery
safety_requirements: Never reuse the source's sshpass or disabled host-key-checking pattern
Do not launch an unknown package or incomplete manifest
Disclose and approve any reset, reboot, firmware, stress or state-changing subtest before execution
Preserve raw results and do not hide skipped, aborted or infrastructure-error cases
Stop on unexpected GPU/system error, thermal/power limit, storage exhaustion, connectivity loss or unsupported platform state
No automatic suite or subtest retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify package/manifest/reference hashes and compatibility inputs
Preflight storage, console and monitoring readiness
Parse raw result artifacts and independently calculate the required-case denominator
Perform no unapproved suite launch, privileged/state-changing subtest, reboot, reset, retry or verdict
engineer_actions: Provide and approve package, full L0/L1 manifest and references
Approve compatibility, privileges, runtime, safety limits and recovery
Review complete raw evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The inventory concept is relevant, but its embedded password, disabled host-key verification and truncated GPU output are unsafe and insufficient for qualification.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor-documented pinned NVSSVT launcher only after package approval; collect inventory separately through authenticated host verification and preserve complete outputs.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All L0/L1 suites, cited NVIDIA references, 100% criterion and 30/300-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: PACKAGE-GATED GRACE NVSSVT QUALIFICATION WITH EXPLICIT DENOMINATOR
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Generate an immutable run manifest binding DUT inventory, reference revisions, tool hashes and required cases; monitor the run independently and calculate 100% from signed per-case outcomes.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds secure access, artifact identity, compatibility, denominator/skip policy, safety monitoring and recovery without reducing L0/L1 coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Inventory proves environment identity only; it cannot substitute for any NVSSVT test result or the aggregate criterion.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A vendor qualification catalog may select cases dynamically by platform capability. Without the resolved expansion and reason codes, a displayed 100% can exclude unsupported, skipped or never-selected tests and falsely appear complete.

project_override_considerations: Project waivers or capability exclusions must name exact case IDs and remain outside the raw pass numerator; they require owner approval and cannot silently convert missing coverage into 100%. An internal mirror may replace NVOnline access only with verified revisions/hashes.
expected_evidence: DUT/software/firmware inventory and approved compatibility matrix
NVSSVT binary/package/reference hashes, license and resolved L0/L1 manifest
Per-case start/end, outcome, exit code, stdout/stderr/artifacts and monitoring timeline
Independent total/pass/fail/skip/error denominator calculation proving or disproving 100%

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently require complete L0/L1 NVSSVT with 100% pass rate. Missing proprietary artifacts and denominator details are readiness inputs, not competing source statements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The case is package-gated rather than intrinsically impossible. Static review is complete; execution waits for the licensed package, resolved manifest and approvals.

review_improvement: Converts an insecure inventory suggestion into a traceable package-gated qualification contract with full manifest, denominator, monitoring and recovery controls.
independent_technical_reasoning: A suite-level percentage is meaningful only after resolving the exact set of tests selected for this Grace configuration. If unsupported or unselected cases disappear before aggregation, 100% may describe only the executed subset. Binding the expanded manifest to the DUT and counting skips/errors separately prevents an inventory check or vendor summary banner from masquerading as complete L0/L1 qualification.
